newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank shares mixed in Beirut.
newsitem.headline: Bank shares mixed in Beirut.

text.p: Bank shares were mixed on the Beirut Stock Exchange with Audi steady at 15.875 and Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce down to $12 from $12.25.
Audi had risen steadily since it began trading last Monday. Turnover rose to 53,000 shares including 20,000 traded in block outside the BSE. This compared with 25,392 shares traded on Friday.
BLC, which had surged to a high of $12.25 after it began trading at $11.25 on December 30, fell on a 2,000-share turnover against 5,000 on Friday.
Banque Audi and Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce are the first two Lebanese banks listed on the Beirut Stock Exchange since it reopened in January 1996.
Solidere A fell on Monday to its low of $10.25 from $10.75 on Friday while B shares rose to $11.125 from $10.625.
There was no trade in the four other firms listed on the BSE: Ciments Libanais, Ciments Blancs, Eternit and Uniceramic.
Total BSE volume rose to 131,898 from 78,765. Turnover was $1,595,474 against $980,771.625.
The LISPI stock index fell 0.25 percent to 81.21.
